modality_prompt:
Judge the scene from the original RGB images. Each image has frame_ref, width, height and actionable. Images follow during_action then surroundings; only actionable ending views can supply image targets. Use their times to distinguish history from current evidence.
For an image target, copy frame_ref and give integer pixel_xy=[u,v] in that original image: origin at top-left, u rightward, v downward, 0<=u<width and 0<=v<height. For navigation choose standable ground near the target; for suppression choose a visible burning solid surface near the fire base, avoiding flame and smoke pixels. If no reliable point is visible, move to observe again. The executor resolves depth and coordinates; handle grounding failures using their feedback.
Person appearance does not establish identity or precise health. Assess fire from images; a completed spray command does not establish extinguishment. Follower feedback uses system-supplied civilian names.
